16752.d: The Mahjarrat Ritual Site is an icy region located between the Trollweiss Mountains and Wilderness.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
Mahjarrat Ritual Site can be reached via three ways:
• Use the fairy ring code DKQ, then exit the Glacor Cave. It requires completion of the quest Ritual of the Mahjarrat.
• Using the canoe in the Rellekka Hunter area north-east of Rellekka and sailing to the site from there. It requires partial completion of the quest the Tale of the Muspah.
• Using the Ghorrock Teleport, Ice Plateau Teleport, or Wilderness obelisk (level 44, equivalent to the obelisk shard, portable obelisk) to Frozen Waste Plateau and travel through Ghorrock to the site. It requires partial completion of the quest the Temple at Senntisten.

16761.d: A mahogany armchair is a piece of furniture that can be built in the chair space hotspot of the parlour in a player-owned house.

16762.d: The mahogany armour case is a piece of furniture that can be built in the costume room of a player-owned house with the Construction skill.
16762.ex: A case for you to keep your armour in.

16763.d: A mahogany bench can be built in the seating space hotspot of the dining room or throne room in a player-owned house.

16764.d: A mahogany bookcase can be built in the bookcase space hotspot of the parlour, quest hall, and study in a player-owned house.

16765.d: The mahogany cape rack is a piece of furniture that can be built in the costume room of a player-owned house with the Construction skill.
16765.ex: A cape rack for you to hang your capes on.

16766.d: Mahogany chest is a scenery found in the Gnome Village Dungeon.

g.label: Mahogany chest
g.how: {{Object map}} on wiki page 'Mahogany chest (Gnome Village Dungeon)'

16767.d: A mahogany chest is the second best crate that can be built in the treasure room of a player-owned house.
16767.ex: There must surely be treasure in a chest this expensive!

16768.d: A mahogany demon lectern is built in the study of a player-owned house.
16768.ex: A book full of arcane knowledge. Allows you to create tablets very quickly.

16769.d: The mahogany dresser is a piece of furniture that can be built in the bedroom of a player-owned house with the Construction skill.
16769.ex: To help you do your hair.

16770.d: A mahogany eagle lectern is a Lectern, built in the study of a player-owned house.
16770.ex: A book full of arcane knowledge. Allows you to create tablets very quickly.

16771.d: The mahogany fancy dress box (previously known as mahogany costume box or mahogany cos box in the Grand Exchange and task system) is a piece of furniture that can be built in the costume room of a player-owned house with the Construction skill.
16771.ex: A box for you to keep clothing.

16772.d: Mahogany incense burners are pieces of furniture that can be built in the chapel of a player-owned house with the Construction skill.
16772.ex: The smoke goes up to the gods.

16773.d: A mahogany ladder can be built in the ladder hotspot of the oubliette in a player-owned house.

16774.d: A mahogany lever is a lever which may be built in the throne room of a player-owned house.
16774.ex: Pull this to activate your machinery of doom!

16775.d: The mahogany magic wardrobe is a piece of furniture that can be built in the costume room of a player-owned house with the Construction skill.
16775.ex: Stores a variety of different clothing.

16776.d: The mahogany pet feeder requires the teak pet feeder to be built.
16776.ex: A mahogany pet feeder that can feed thirty pets.

16777.d: A mahogany pet house is built in the menagerie of a player-owned house.
16777.ex: A mahogany pet house that can house 15 pets.

16778.d: A mahogany portal can be built in the portal chamber of a player-owned house.

16779.d: A mahogany prize chest is the best crate that can be built in the games room in a player-owned house.

16780.d: A mahogany table can be built in the table hotspot of the Dining Room in a player-owned house.

16781.d: A mahogany telescope can be built in the telescope space of the study in a player-owned house.
16781.ex: Try to make sense of what you see and wonder about what makes the universe exist.

16782.d: A mahogany throne can be built in the throne hotspot of the throne room in a player-owned house.
16782.ex: Sit here and rule all you survey.

16783.d: A mahogany toy box is a piece of furniture that can be built in the costume room of a player-owned house with the Construction skill.

16784.d: A mahogany trapdoor can be built in the trapdoor hotspot of the throne room in a player-owned house.
16784.ex: Go through this mahogany trapdoor to see what is below your throne room.

16785.d: The mahogany treasure chest is a piece of furniture that can be built in the costume room of a player-owned house with the Construction skill.

16786.d: The mahogany wardrobe is a piece of furniture that can be built in the Bedroom of a player-owned house with the Construction skill.
16786.ex: A place to keep all your clothes.

16787.d: Maiasaura is a music track that is unlocked during the fight against the Dagannoth Mother from the Blood Runs Deep quest.
